statement: SDL3.2.10 OpenJoystick unconditionally initializes/resets the extension before GetMotionPlusState. Under Linux its MotionPlus activation function neither sends the restoring map write nor assigns the cached active mode. Sensor registration/enable is not proof of gyro dispatch: dispatch also requires non-NONE cached mode. Ordinary periodic presence handling does not recover that mode merely because a kernel client later restores mapping. W5 virtual-host arms observe SDL A400F0 resets around these public API boundaries and no gyro events, including holder arms with later active readbacks and kernel gyro delivery. This supports a bounded consumer reset/ownership limitation; private cached mode was not directly instrumented and disconnects prevent uniquely assigning every zero to that variable. It does not assert all SDL Wii configurations fail or physical Wii equivalence.
